[ली-अच्] 
__1 Sticking, union, adherence. 
__2 Lurking, hiding. 
__3 Fusion, melting, solution. 
__4 Disappearance, dissolution, extinction, destruction; universal destruction (प्रलय); लयं या ‘to be dissolved or destroyed’. 
__5 Absorption of the mind, deep concentration, exclusive devotion (to any one object); पश्यन्ती शिवरूपिणं लयवशादात्मानमभ्यागता [[

.]] 
__6 Time in music (of three kinds- द्रुत, मध्य, and विलम्बित); किसलयैः सलयैरिव पाणिभिः [[

.]] 
__7 A pause in music. 
__8 Rest, repose. 
__9 A place of rest, abode, habitation; अलया [[Śi. 4. 57]] ‘having no fixed abode, wandering’. 
__10 Slackness of mind, mental inactivity; (also used in adjectival sense; यदा जयेद्रजः सत्त्वं तमो मूढं लयं जडम् [[

.]]). 
__11 An embrace. 
__12 The Supreme Being. 
__13 The union of song, dance, and instrumental music; गायतं मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् [[

.]] 
__14 A swoon. 
__15 The quick (downward) movement of an arrow. 
-Comp. 
-अर्कः the sun at the destruction of the universe. 
-आरम्भः, -आलम्भः an actor, a dancer. 
-कालः the time of destruction (of the world.). 
-गत a. dissolved, melted away. 
-नालिकः a Buddhist or Jain temple. 
-पुत्री an actress, a female dancer. 
-मध्य a. to be performed in moderate time (a piece of music). 
-शुद्ध a. to be performed in right time. 
-स्थानम् a place of dissolution.

[ली-ल्युट्] 
__1 Adhering, clinging, sticking. 
__2 Rest, repose. 
__3 A place of rest, house.
